visualFindings.branding: Original diamond PROJECT, warm beveled DOLLAR and emerald moneybag are complete, aligned and legible. Corner glints and letter surface reflections do not obscure typography.
visualFindings.entrance: Photographic-style chrome has continuous clean rails and a broad lower casting. Narrow bright emission stays within the colored channel while darker navy recesses and neutral metal reflections remain visible.
visualFindings.environments: NFL sapphire, fixed NBA blue-left/red-right, NRL emerald and UFC ruby remain distinct. All four decorative scenes are visible immediately in the hosted originals.
visualFindings.gemButton: Facet geometry remains defined and smooth, with native aspect and a crisp translucent label. Coming soon labels remain intact and fit inside gem faces.
visualFindings.sportSelectors: All four icon-only glass selectors retain their marks, coherent edge lighting and visible selection; no clipped icons, repeated labels or Home bottom navigation returned.
visualFindings.framing: The compact corridor and floor fade reproduce the accepted local composition. Additional portrait height stays black instead of stretching wet pavement below the dock.
visualFindings.localComparison: No material difference beyond naturally sampled animation phase, and no visible hosting-induced degradation or missing imagery.
